Planning a trip to Sotogrande in 2032 and want to get on the water without a license? Our no license boat rental in Sotogrande 2032 makes it easy. All our charters include a licensed skipper, so you don't need any qualifications. Just bring your group and enjoy the Costa del Sol from the sea. Prices start at €749 for 2 hours on an Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39, with drinks and snacks included. Depart from Puerto Banús, just 30 minutes from Sotogrande.

Why Choose No License Boat Rental in Sotogrande 2032?

Renting a boat without a license is the simplest way to explore the coast. You avoid paperwork, exams, and insurance hassles. Our skippers know the local waters—from Estepona to Gibraltar—and handle navigation while you sunbathe, swim, or enjoy the views of La Concha mountain. With over 15 boats in our fleet, there's an option for every group size and budget.

What's Included in Your Charter

Every booking includes: licensed skipper, fuel, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish VAT (21%). You also get unlimited water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks. No extra costs. Just show up at Puerto Banús and step aboard.

Popular Destinations from Sotogrande

Your skipper can take you to: Estepona (old town views), Cabopino (quiet coves), Cala del Faro (swimming spot), Cala Cortés (secluded beach), or Gibraltar (see the Rock from sea). The typical route heads east along the coast, passing Marbella's Golden Mile and Puerto Banús. For a longer trip, go west to Sotogrande marina itself.

How to Book Your No License Boat Rental in Sotogrande 2032

Booking is straightforward. For Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39), you can reserve online with a deposit. For all other boats, message us on WhatsApp with your preferred date, group size, and duration. We'll confirm availability and send a quote.
